widgets_values: One continuous 5-second cinematic product shot, shot on a full-frame DSLR with an 85mm f/1.8 lens. A white wall-mounted plastic bag holder is stuck on the side panel of a brushed-steel fridge in a clean modern kitchen; soft morning daylight comes from a window on the left. A hand enters from the right edge, pulls a fresh semi-transparent plastic bag out of the holder in one smooth downward motion, and the bag opens slightly as it comes free. The holder stays clean and mounted, nothing else moves. Camera: a slow steady push-in with a slight downward tilt toward the holder, single uninterrupted take, no cuts. Photorealistic: real photographic texture, visible material grain, natural highlight falloff, shallow depth of field with gentle focus falloff, subtle film grain over the whole frame, natural warm colour grade. Keep the exact same product shape as the reference image throughout - correct proportions, rounded corners, the three vertical slots on the front and the horizontal pull-out slot must stay identical. No text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no extra hands, no deformed product.

widgets_values:
【星梦工厂 · H3 武打合并版】
骨架 = 你实跑过的 W1（229币/条，12s 单镜，性价比最高）。

两档，一键切换（在画布上选中节点按 Ctrl+B）：
· 省钱档（默认）= 现在这样。二采放大支线 185/186/187 处于 bypass，采完直接解码。
· 高清档 = 选中 185/186/187 三个节点一起取消 bypass（Ctrl+B），latent 会 ×2 放大后再采一遍，
  画面更清、动作边缘更实，代价是时间与积分上去（约当三件套那档）。

参考图口：
· 图1（137）= 主角，必填。
· 图2（152）= 对手；图3（162）= 场景。这两个默认 bypass，要用就取消 bypass 再加载图片。

提示词：138 里是结构化模板（主体定义 / 概述 / 运镜 / 物理 / 守恒）。
照着填，别删段落——W1 原作者的提示词就是这么分段的，模型吃这套结构。

已静音的支线：198 出图支线（Qwen 20 个 LoRA）跟成片无关，已设静音，不参与执行。

注意：
· 时长 132 默认 12 秒，是这条流验证过的值；改短会更省，改长容易动作发散。
· 24G 跑 1.0MP 安全；要 1.5MP 以上换 Plus(48G)。
· 出虚影：调度器 beta 12 步，或把 154 的 sigma 扩展关掉（bypass）。

bunny_workflow.purpose: MiniMax H3 martial-arts motion, temporal continuity and clean low-noise finishing
bunny_workflow.name: BUNNY Combat H3

two_stage_sampling_notes.tuning: If still soft, raise split denoise from 0.25 to 0.30 or reduce stage-2 Turbo to 0.10. If motion weakens, lower split denoise to 0.20.
two_stage_sampling_notes.stage_1: Original Turbo 0.7 + Combat 1.0; high sigma branch; preserves motion logic.
two_stage_sampling_notes.stage_2: DisableNoise; Turbo 0.25 + Combat 0.70; final 25% low sigma branch; restores detail.
